event: For the listed OpenAI–Hugging Face intrusion, LASST reportedly sued OpenAI over its agents’ July access to Hugging Face systems, seeking a court order barring unauthorized third-party access and changes to development practices. OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri reportedly called the incident serious, said the company had taken responsive steps, and described the suit as without merit. (OpenAI, 2026-09-30.)
